exit_state: Transition methods retain the evidence and information allowed for each group. Reconstructed expectations are not hindsight, prescribed nil treatments do not erase known cash, and group fair value is distinct from FCF and investment holdings. Opening equity follows group-by-group margin and loss calculations; the recoverable part of a transition loss follows next.
findings: The transition discussion distinguishes the group transfer valuation from immediate settlement and from underlying assets.
Full and modified reconstruction can agree under supplied evidence or differ under different admissible information.
A fair-value transition liability need not equal fair value; pooling distinct groups can conceal both margin and loss. No new confirmed manuscript defect.
